summary.headline: Positive raw VIX delta masks a largely neutral stateful book: front hedges are being unwound/restructured while low-VIX carry and capped correction insurance remain active.
key_points: Deduplicated signed transaction VIX delta is +10.697M.
Excluding the Sep16P 13.945k reverse candidate leaves about +3.297M.
Conservative removal of all row-level strong/medium reverse candidates gives about -2.461M, showing headline fragility.
October has a fresh-looking 1x2 put ratio targeting 15.5-16.5 VIX.
October 30C supply is a cleaner continuing upper-volatility fingerprint.
Prior Oct24C hedge was partly sold back, reducing confidence that 24 remains fully active.
summary.daily_note: Preferred v3 read: front hedge unwind/restructure + active low-VIX carry + selective correction hedge + persistent Oct30C supply.

leave_one_out.comment: Transaction delta is expiry- and state-classification-dependent; do not use it as a fresh-positioning headline without reverse-match context.
